title: Tokens ↔ Neurons ↔ Memory — Attention as Selective Synchrony

Tokens ↔ Neurons ↔ Memory

Attention as Selective Synchrony

Attention as selective synchrony: In LLMs, multi-head attention forms weighted links among tokens; in the brain, synchronized oscillations and neuromodulators dynamically gate which neural assemblies co-activate. Both implement context-dependent routing of relevance.
